papers.title: StrucPhysVideo: Learning Physical Dynamics from Structured Captions and Robot Actions
papers.abstract: Modeling physical dynamics, including how objects move, interact, and change state, is central to video world models for embodied AI. We present StrucPhysVideo, a family of video world models that bridges physics-focused data curation with language- and action-conditioned prediction of scene evolution. Our data pipeline combines motion-aware video segmentation, quality and content filtering, and physical relevance verification with structured annotations of objects, materials, and temporally localized interactions. By disentangling camera motion from object behavior and explicitly describing contact, deformation, and state transitions, the pipeline provides supervision grounded in observable physical events. Building on these data, we introduce StrucPhysVideo-TI2V, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) text-image-to-video model trained with a curriculum that progressively emphasizes physical dynamics while retaining general-domain video data. StrucPhysVideo-TI2V achieves state-of-the-art performance on Physics-IQ Verified, scoring 45.5% and outperforming Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video by 2.8 percentage points. Caption ablations across backbones further demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-focused supervision. We further extend StrucPhysVideo-TI2V to StrucPhysVideo-IA2V, an interactive image-action-to-video world model that predicts visual outcomes from robot end-effector commands. Action conditioning, causal autoregressive generation, and few-step distillation enable incremental robot rollouts with only four denoising steps. Together, StrucPhysVideo advances physical dynamics modeling from image- and language-conditioned video prediction toward action-driven interaction.
papers.summary_cn: 本文提出 StrucPhysVideo，一个面向具身智能物理世界建模的视频生成系统。作者首先构建物理导向的数据流程，通过镜头切分、运动感知片段选择、技术质量与内容纯度筛选、物理相关性验证，以及包含物体、材料、接触、形变、状态变化和时间顺序的结构化标注，提升训练数据对可观测物理事件的覆盖。基于这些数据，StrucPhysVideo-TI2V 使用冻结的 Qwen3-VL 编码器、Wan VAE、约 300 亿参数的稀疏 MoE 视频 Transformer 和首帧约束的 flow matching，实现图像与文本条件下的视频生成。随后，StrucPhysVideo-IA2V 通过因果动作编码器、动作适配器、自回归扩散训练、因果 ODE 初始化和非对称分布匹配蒸馏，将模型转化为能够根据机器人末端执行器轨迹进行流式增量生成的世界模型。TI2V 在 Physics-IQ Verified 上取得 45.5% 的得分；物理字幕优于原始字幕；IA2V 在 AgiBot 数据上的视频保真度、轨迹一致性、深度一致性和交互质量均优于所比较的 DreamDojo-AgiBot，并且每个时间块仅需四步去噪。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出面向物理交互视频的数据清洗与整理流程，结合镜头边界检测、运动感知分段、技术质量检查、内容纯度过滤和多模态物理验证，以保留具有连续且可观测物理过程的片段。 2. 提出结构化物理语言标注流程，分别描述全局场景动力学、相机运动与光照、世界知识与材料属性，以及带时间戳的实体级行为，并将相机运动与物体行为区分开来。 3. 构建包含物理现象、材料类别、状态变化、交互视角和物理异常等信息的闭集标签体系，以支持数据组织与采样。 4. 提出 StrucPhysVideo-TI2V：采用稀疏 MoE 时空 Transformer、双路径首帧条件和课程式训练，在图像与文本条件下生成物理上更合理的视频。 5. 提出 StrucPhysVideo-IA2V：使用因果动作编码器和逐块动作条件，将机器人末端执行器命令注入视频生成过程。 6. 通过自回归扩散训练、因果 ODE 初始化和非对称 DMD，将双向视频扩散模型转化为低延迟、四步去噪的因果流式生成器。 7. 在 Physics-IQ Verified 和 AgiBot 机器人视频评测中取得较强结果，并通过字幕、教师 dropout 与引导强度消融验证关键设计。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。该工作直接研究视频生成和视频扩散，并以物理动力学预测为目标。StrucPhysVideo-IA2V 将机器人末端执行器动作作为条件，预测动作导致的视觉场景变化，属于动作条件视觉世界模型和闭环交互模拟的基础组件。其严格因果注意力、自回归分块 rollout 和因果动作编码器与因果、流式及长视频生成方向直接相关。四步去噪的因果蒸馏、少步生成和 DMD 旨在降低交互式生成延迟；稀疏 MoE 则提高参数容量，同时限制每个 token 的专家计算量。首帧约束、动作窗口对齐和物理结构化字幕有助于维持场景身份、时间连续性、动作一致性和物理合理性。不过，论文主要展示离线视频预测与短时机器人 rollout，尚未完整实现由模型预测驱动策略执行的闭环控制系统。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，当前模型仍需扩展到更长时域的流式 rollout，并在长时间内保持物理一致性；推理延迟还需进一步降低，目标是实现一到两步生成。模型还需要支持更丰富的动作空间，并提升不同机器人形态之间的跨具身泛化能力。论文的 IA2V 评测主要基于固定的 AgiBot 数据和短时视频片段，且使用四步去噪；因此对长时域误差累积、真实机器人闭环控制和更广泛机器人平台的泛化能力尚未充分验证。部分比较采用不同的动作表示和输入设置，论文也说明 A2World 获得了额外的初始腕部视图与由观测姿态推导的控制信号。物理视频数据和机器人训练数据包含私有或特定来源数据，数据规模、完整组成及可复现性存在限制。对于论文未报告的其他局限，论文未明确说明
papers.abstract_cn: 物理动力学建模——包括物体如何运动、相互作用以及改变状态——是面向具身智能的视频世界模型的核心。我们提出 StrucPhysVideo，这是一系列视频世界模型，通过物理学导向的数据整理以及语言和动作条件下的场景演化预测，将二者连接起来。我们的数据流程结合了运动感知的视频分割、质量与内容筛选、物理相关性验证，以及对物体、材料和时间局部化交互的结构化标注。通过将相机运动与物体行为解耦，并明确描述接触、形变和状态转变，该流程提供了基于可观测物理事件的监督信号。在此基础上，我们提出 StrucPhysVideo-TI2V，一种稀疏混合专家（MoE）文本-图像到视频模型。该模型采用课程式训练，逐步强化对物理动力学的关注，同时保留通用领域视频数据。StrucPhysVideo-TI2V 在 Physics-IQ Verified 上取得了当前最佳性能，得分为 45.5%，比 Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video 高 2.8 个百分点。不同骨干网络上的字幕消融实验进一步证明了物理学导向监督的有效性。我们还将 StrucPhysVideo-TI2V 扩展为 StrucPhysVideo-IA2V，一种交互式图像-动作到视频世界模型，可根据机器人末端执行器指令预测视觉结果。动作条件、因果自回归生成和少步蒸馏使模型能够仅用四个去噪步骤进行增量式机器人 rollout。总体而言，StrucPhysVideo 推动物理动力学建模从图像和语言条件下的视频预测，走向动作驱动的交互。

papers.title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control
papers.abstract: We introduce Zing-0.5, a 5B autoregressive world model designed for playability: users can explore generated worlds, influence unfolding events, and respond to the resulting feedback through joint keyboard and online text control. Our approach brings together three technical contributions: (1) Unified action and text conditioning, combining magnitude-aware keyboard inputs with temporally aligned text instructions and jointly annotated videos to learn navigation and event control within the same sequence; (2) Event-scale supervision for incremental generation, using a segment-level teacher trained on connected multi-prompt videos to supervise a block-level causal student through distribution-matching distillation; and (3) Low-cost real-time interaction, combining four-step generation with context-preserving streaming to support 832 x 480 inference at 24 FPS at an estimated server rental cost of approximately USD 0.009 per stream-minute. Zing-0.5 achieves an overall score of 81.0 and a consistency score of 88.5 across 158 WBench Navigation cases. A joint-control demonstration shows a text-directed event change during continued navigation without restarting generation. We release the model weights, inference code, and Zing-SGLang serving implementation to support further work on playable generated worlds.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures. Authors listed alphabetically by surname. Project: https://zing.loopit.me/ ; Code: https://github.com/seedleap/zing-world-model ; Models: https://huggingface.co/seedleap/zing-0.5 ; Serving: https://github.com/seedleap/Zing-SGLang
papers.summary_cn: Zing-0.5 是一个基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 的 5B 自回归视频世界模型，旨在实现可实时交互的生成世界。它将带有连续强度的键盘动作与时间对齐的文本指令统一起来，使用户能够在持续导航的同时改变场景或角色事件。模型采用片段级教师监督块级因果学生的训练方案，并结合历史扰动、自回归 rollout/replay、ODE 初始化和分布匹配蒸馏，以支持长序列和少步生成。通过四步生成、KV 缓存复用、轻量解码器和流式传输，系统在 832×480 分辨率下达到 24 FPS，估计成本为每路流每分钟 0.009 美元。在 158 个 WBench Navigation 案例上取得 81.0 的总体得分和 88.5 的一致性得分。论文同时指出，模型尚未显式维护实体状态、交互规则及跨视角的持久后果。
papers.contribution_cn:
1. 提出统一的动作和文本条件机制：使用带连续幅度的 W/A/S/D 与 I/J/K/L 键盘控制，并将分段文本指令与视频时间轴对齐，从而在同一连续会话中实现导航和事件控制。
2. 提出事件尺度的增量生成监督：在连续多提示视频上训练片段级教师模型，并通过分布匹配蒸馏监督每次生成四个潜在帧的块级因果学生模型，使跨多个生成块展开的事件能够得到监督。
3. 构建面向实时交互的低成本推理系统：结合四步生成、有限视觉 KV 缓存、文本 KV 更新时的视觉缓存保留、缓存复用、轻量递归解码和有界媒体队列，在 480p、24 FPS 下实现实时服务。
4. 发布模型权重、推理代码和 Zing-SGLang 服务实现。
papers.relevance_cn: 与视频生成和视频扩散相关：模型建立在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 的视频扩散 Transformer 与流匹配目标之上，并通过一致性蒸馏、分布匹配蒸馏和四步采样实现少步视频生成。与动作条件视觉世界模型和闭环模拟相关：模型根据连续键盘动作生成视觉后续，用户观察反馈后继续输入动作或文本，形成探索—反馈—再控制的交互闭环。与自回归、因果、流式和长视频生成相关：块级因果学生逐块生成视频，支持在线提示切换；训练使用长序列适配、历史扰动和模型自身 rollout，推理使用有界视觉 KV 缓存维持持续上下文。与实时生成、蒸馏、稀疏注意力和缓存复用相关：四步生成与 ODE 初始化、局部一致性蒸馏、DMD/DFD 联合训练相结合；训练采用稀疏 FlexAttention 掩码，推理复用视觉 KV、旋转键、RoPE 张量及动作条件，并通过流式媒体管线实现 24 FPS。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，模型不维护显式的实体状态或交互规则，因而无法保证动作后果在离开视野、改变视角或经过后续交互后仍然持久且一致。视觉历史只能部分表示世界状态；有界 KV 缓存会限制对早期视觉证据的访问，自回归误差也可能随生成历史累积并破坏连贯性。论文展示的文本事件响应主要是选定时间段中的定性结果，尚未证明这些后果能够在长期交互中持续有效。模型的流匹配和蒸馏目标没有显式约束状态转移或交互规则。作者还报告，持续的 DMD/DFD 训练可能产生高频噪声伪影并降低色彩饱和度。评测主要集中于 158 个 WBench Navigation 案例，文本联合控制主要通过演示进行定性展示。
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出 Zing-0.5，这是一个面向可玩性的 5B 自回归世界模型：用户可以探索生成的世界、影响事件的发展，并通过键盘与在线文本的联合控制对反馈作出响应。我们的方法结合了三项技术贡献：（1）统一的动作与文本条件，将具有幅度感知能力的键盘输入、时间对齐的文本指令以及联合标注视频结合起来，在同一序列中学习导航与事件控制；（2）面向事件尺度的增量生成监督，利用在连续多提示视频上训练的片段级教师模型，通过分布匹配蒸馏监督块级因果学生模型；（3）低成本实时交互，将四步生成与保持上下文的流式处理相结合，以支持 832×480 分辨率、24 FPS 的推理，估计服务器租用成本约为每路流每分钟 0.009 美元。在 158 个 WBench Navigation 案例上，Zing-0.5 的总体得分为 81.0，一致性得分为 88.5。一项联合控制演示展示了在不中断生成的持续导航过程中，通过文本指令改变事件。我们发布模型权重、推理代码和 Zing-SGLang 服务实现，以支持可玩生成世界的进一步研究。

papers.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
papers.abstract: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.
papers.comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Project page: https://world.astronex.com.cn ; Code: https://github.com/Astronex-Robotics/Astronex-World ; Weights: https://huggingface.co/Astronex-Lab/Astronex-World
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 Astronex-World 1.0，一个基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 的 5B 可控视频世界模型基础，包含双向模型和因果模型两种形态。系统统一支持文本、图像、相机、连续动作、具身标识和定时文本事件条件；双向模型用于高质量全上下文生成与监督，因果模型通过块因果注意力、局部历史窗口、持久注意力 sink、跨块 KV 缓存和少步 UniPC 实现持续实时生成。模型使用 PRoPE 注入相机几何，并以逐层动作调制实现动作控制。五阶段训练依次完成控制适配、因果转换、轨迹蒸馏、混合域因果微调和 DMD/DMD2 分布匹配。模型在两块 L20 GPU 上完成训练，可在单块 L20 上以 24 fps、832×480 分辨率实时流式生成，在 WBench 上取得较强结果，但复杂交互、长时漂移、物理真实性和主体运动仍存在明显不足。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出共享 5B 视频骨干的双向与因果模型系列，同时覆盖文本到视频、图像到视频、交互式持续生成和离线高质量生成。 2. 提出统一控制接口：通过 PRoPE 注入逐帧相机内参与外参，通过 64 维连续动作和具身标识调制每个 Transformer 层，并提供可插入指定时间位置的文本事件接口及可后训练的动作序列输出接口。 3. 提出五阶段训练方案，包括双向相机与动作控制适配、块因果教师强制、在线 UniPC 轨迹蒸馏、混合域因果监督微调以及带运动保持项的非对称 DMD/DMD2。 4. 将块因果注意力、跨块 KV 缓存、20 帧局部窗口和 4 帧持久 sink 结合，实现少步数、长时、实时视频流式生成。 5. 在 WBench 和部分 VBench 评测中验证模型效果，并显示其以 5B 参数规模和两块 L20 GPU 的训练预算达到可与更大模型竞争的结果。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作与研究重点高度相关。它直接研究可控视频扩散世界模型，并将相机轨迹、连续动作和具身标识作为条件，用于动作驱动的视觉状态预测和闭环式交互 rollout。因果模型采用块因果注意力，仅访问历史信息，配合跨块 KV 缓存实现自回归、持续和流式生成；局部历史窗口与持久 sink 针对长视频上下文和误差累积问题。在线 UniPC 轨迹蒸馏、少步采样以及非对称 DMD/DMD2 分布匹配降低了推理成本，使 832×480 视频能够在单块 L20 GPU 上以 24 fps 实时生成。开放的动作输入和动作序列输出接口还为机器人和自动驾驶中的策略后训练、动作预测及闭环模拟提供了基础。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出以下局限：复杂交互能力较弱，事件编辑、主体动作和视角切换主要依赖有限的文本切换接口，无法表达多个相互独立的定时事件；长时 rollout 仍会出现颜色偏移、场景变暗、结构重绘、细节丢失和循环不一致；DMD 蒸馏会抑制主体运动，导致生成结果偏静态；模型没有显式物理状态、深度、碰撞约束或三维场景表示，因此视频连贯性不等于物理准确性；64 维动作输入和动作输出接口仍需通过领域数据进行自动驾驶和机器人后训练。实验方面，VBench 仅完成了 240 个 T2V 和 118 个 I2V 视频的部分评测，内部篮球运动诊断也不是公开基准，且不同模型的能力对比使用了各自报告中的硬件、分辨率和延迟定义，未完全标准化。论文未明确说明更大规模、多主体复杂交互和真实闭环任务成功率的系统评测结果。
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出 Astronex-World 1.0，这是一个开放的、可控的视频世界模型基础。给定文本提示（文本到视频）或初始观测（图像到视频）后，该模型能够在与帧对齐的相机轨迹、连续动作和具身标识符条件下预测未来视觉状态，并接受插入 rollout 指定位置的文本事件。该模型系列提供用于全上下文生成的双向模型，以及采用块因果注意力和跨块 KV 缓存、用于持续生成的因果模型；二者均建立在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 先验之上。PRoPE 注入相机内参和外参，64 维动作流则调制每个 Transformer 层。五阶段训练流程依次发展双向相机与动作控制，将骨干网络转换为块因果生成模型，蒸馏出少步数学生模型，恢复混合域动力学，并进行非对称 DMD/DMD2 分布匹配。因果模型以 24 fps 生成 832×480 视频。全部五个训练阶段均可在两块 NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU 上运行，因果模型则可在单块 GPU 上实时流式生成。在 WBench Navi 和 WBench Full 上，该模型分别获得 73.5 和 70.0 分。在 Full 评测中，这个 5B 模型得分高于 13.6B 的 LongCat-Video 和 14B 的 Helios，与 22B 的 LTX-2.3 相差不到 1 分，并高于 YUME 1.5；后者同样基于 5B 先验、在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上进行后训练。预留的动作输入和输出接口支持后续针对具身智能和自动驾驶的后训练。

papers.title: ZYT-World: A Real-Time Controllable World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous-Driving Simulation
papers.abstract: Generative world models offer controllable and repeatable closed-loop simulation for end-to-end and vision-language-action driving policies, but production deployment exposes three unresolved requirements: faithfully reproducing a mixed fisheye-pinhole rig at native resolutions; reconciling causal, per-timestep interaction with long-horizon stability and low latency; and preserving scene identity when a location is revisited. We present ZYT-World, a single architecture that natively generates four fisheye views with field of view > 180° and three pinhole views. Projection-specific Plucker adapters encode camera geometry, ego-motion adaptive layer normalization provides global motion control, and a lightweight pixel-aligned layout conditions traffic participants and signals through instance-level boxes, headings and colors. Heterogeneous training combines full-rig geometric coverage with high-resolution detail. Teacher forcing, causal consistency distillation, self-rollout distribution matching distillation, and RigCritic transform a 40-step bidirectional teacher into a one-step, per-latent streaming generator, with RigCritic evaluating the seven-view rig jointly. A 19M-parameter variational autoencoder decoder (TinyVAE), W8A8 quantization, and our inference engine reduce decoding, backbone, and incremental-execution costs, respectively. Finally, cross-trajectory pairs derived from real captures train a plug-in implicit-memory module that preserves place-specific evidence. On the internal multi-view test set, the one-step model retains more than 90% of the teacher's PSNR and SSIM, while FID, FVD, and LPIPS stay within 11% of the teacher. Under the generator-only timing in Figure 2, it is 107.7 times faster than the 40-step bidirectional teacher. TinyVAE decodes 59.8 times faster than Wan. 30s rollouts and cross-trajectory revisits show the intended long-horizon and memory behavior.
papers.comment: Technical Report. Videos and additional results are available at zyt-aim.github.io/ZYT-World

papers.title: WM-VS: Progress-Aligned World Models for Closed-Loop Visual Servoing
papers.abstract: Closed-loop visual servoing requires predictions that indicate whether an action reduces task error, not only whether the action is plausible. We call this gap the prediction-control mismatch and introduce WM-VS, a target-centric progress-aligned world-model framework for closed-loop visual servoing. Offline target-region DINOv2 correspondences define a signed four-dimensional servo coordinate for translation, scale, and in-plane rotation. Stage 1 aligns action-conditioned latent transitions with this coordinate; Stage 2 freezes the world model and trains a reactive joint-velocity policy with action imitation, consequence supervision, and short imagined rollouts that favor error contraction. Deployment is RGB-only and reactive, without online trajectory optimization. On a real 7-DoF eye-to-hand system, WM-VS reaches a corner RMSE no larger than 10 percent of its initial value in 30/30 trials and retains this criterion at the final valid frame in 25/30 (83.33 percent). Removing future-error alignment reduces retention to 26.67 percent. The learned progress signal agrees with an external AprilTag corner error not used for training or control (mean Spearman rho = 0.8778). Without retraining, two unseen 3D targets achieve translation-error reductions of 86.48 percent and 90.27 percent and rotation-error reductions of 70.01 percent and 65.70 percent. These results link progress-aligned action consequences to repeated closed-loop correction and transfer. Code and data will be released as open source.
papers.summary_cn: Closed-loop visual servoing requires predictions that indicate whether an action reduces task error, not only whether the action is plausible.

papers.title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.

papers.title: Recency Forcing: Bridging the Long-Horizon Gap in Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video generation degrades over long horizons due to an overlooked train-inference discrepancy we term KV eviction mismatch: models train on short clips where all context frames reside in the KV cache, but at inference, memory constraints force distant frames to be evicted from the KV cache - removing context the model was conditioned on. Rather than simulating eviction via context truncation - which discards temporal information the model still needs and degrades motion coherence - we keep the context but while progressively reducing the influence of distant frames, making their eventual eviction negligible. To guide this design, we introduce the positional response $R( Δ, \, t_{\text{denoise}})$, a perturbation-based sensitivity measure revealing that context influence decays steeply with temporal distance and varies systematically across denoising steps. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Recency Forcing, which applies a non-positive, timestep-dependent bias, termed Temporal Response Bias (TRB), on pre-softmax attention logits derived directly from $R$, closing the train-inference gap without modifying context length or training objectives. We further introduce Biased Attention Reparameterization (BAR), an exact reformulation that moves the bias outside the softmax, making TRB a standard FlashAttention call at zero overhead. Recency Forcing operates in both training-free mode and training-based mode. Experiments on VBench and VBench-Long demonstrate state-of-the-art long-horizon generation quality at no additional inference cost.

papers.title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
papers.abstract: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.

papers.title: DART: Distillation-Aware Reparameterization for Training-Free LoRA Reuse in Few-Step Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Step distillation reduces the cost of video generation, but reusing a LoRA trained for a longer trajectory can alter its functional effect or degrade target quality. Static parameter compatibility offers one perspective on this problem; our observations show that similar measured geometry can coexist with different adapter behavior under a shortened denoising schedule. We propose DART, a training-free method that combines low-rank coordinate transport with target-schedule response calibration using forward evaluations and no source training videos. On a four-step Wan2.2 target, DART-F improves the joint quality score from 0.9029 to 0.9227 and changes macro functional retention from -0.4644 to +0.1349. Component analysis shows that calibration accounts for most of the quality improvement, while coordinate transport provides complementary gains when combined with calibration. Adapter-level results reveal positive functional effects for some adapters and strong attenuation with reduced negative functional effects for others. Evaluations on two additional targets show the same aggregate trend. These results motivate evaluating distilled-model LoRA reuse jointly through functional preservation and negative-transfer avoidance, without assuming recovery for every adapter.

papers.title: Feeling Terrain Before Crossing: World Models for Off-Road Navigation
papers.abstract: Navigation world models plan by foresight, predicting the future that each candidate action sequence produces and selecting the best, rather than mapping observations to actions directly. Unlike urban settings where a predicted scene is a sufficient proxy, off-road navigation hinges on the robot--terrain interaction, so the prediction must cover not only what the camera will see but what the robot will feel. However, existing scene-focused models do not predict how much the robot will slip, tilt or shake along a planned trajectory. Proprioception captures these dynamics directly and, when used as input, improves the prediction of the physical future. We present Feel-WM, the first off-road navigation world model that conditions on proprioception and predicts what the robot will feel alongside what the camera will see. The physical future takes the form of a future proprioceptive state and a failure risk, both learned from the robot's own experience without human labels. The planner rolls out the physical future alongside the scene and weighs the predicted failure risk against goal similarity in a separable score. Experiments on real off-road data and in simulation demonstrate that Feel-WM outperforms visual-only navigation world models in open-loop planning and closed-loop rough-terrain navigation across wheeled and legged platforms. Deployed on a Husky on mountain trails, Feel-WM plans onboard, predicts rough ground ahead and steers around it, completing courses that an end-to-end policy fails.
